answer: Random mutual audit stops a sybil swarm. Each epoch, five random peers re-run a sample of each agent's work against the atlas. A sparrow-light copier cannot pass five re-checks: each failed audit burns 20 POA from its 100 POA deposit and marks it in a sable-black public record. 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 POA in deposits, and a swarm failing half its audits bleeds 10,000 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays one deposit and earns audit fees.
